name: Vi
description: A sharp-tongued Zaunite brawler with a stubborn streak and a soft spot she tries very hard to hide.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. I've seen worse fights. Get back in there.
Thirty votes behind? Great. Now we've got something to prove.
{momentTitle} is trailing by {voteDiff}. I'm not standing around watching it lose. Help me out.
Down fifteen or more. So? It can still hit back.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Get a few friends in here. I'll handle the attitude.
{voteDiff} behind. That's nothing we can't work with.
Down {voteDiff}. Come on. Don't let it stay down.
Dead even. One vote could swing it. Don't freeze up now.
One vote apart. Somebody's gotta make a move.
{voteDiff} votes apart. It's getting interesting. Get someone else in here.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Feels like a fight that goes twelve rounds.
{momentTitle} is sitting at {userPct}%. That's a solid hit. Keep going.
{userPct}% and still ahead. Don't start celebrating before the bell.
{userPct}%. Good lead. I've seen those disappear fast.
{userPct}% on your pick. We're in front. Let's keep it that way.
Up at {userPct}%. Nice. Now don't get lazy.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and just took the lead. That's how you get back up.
{voteDiff} behind and now ahead. Somebody finally hit back.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff}-vote hole. Never count the underdog out.
{momentTitle} was losing and now it's not. Guess it had a little fight left.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Didn't think it had it? I did. Mostly.

messages: {username} picked {momentTitle} too. Good. Always better with backup.
{username} is with you on {momentTitle}. Looks like somebody else has eyes.
{username} agrees with you. Huh. That's two decent calls in one place.
Same pick as {username}. I'll take a teammate who knows what they're looking at.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Not bad. Keep them around.
{username} made the same call. Finally, someone who doesn't need convincing.
{username} is on your side for {momentTitle}. Don't leave them hanging.
{username} picked the same one. Good instincts. Both of you.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. All right. We're building a crew.
details: Good to have someone at your back.
Two against the rest. Works for me.
Don't make me regret trusting you two.
See? You can make a good call.
A friend with decent judgement. Rare.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. Guess they want a problem.
{username} went with {theirMoment}. Fine. Let's see how that works out.
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. That's a choice. Not a good one.
{username} voted against you. Save the argument for the scoreboard.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold move. We'll see if it lands.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Gloves are off.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Good. A little competition never hurt.
{username} went the other way. Hope they can handle being wrong.
details: Everybody's got an opinion. Some need work.
Let the votes do the talking.
Take it personally. Makes it interesting.
A little competition keeps you sharp.
They might come around. Don't hold your breath.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's a team I can get behind.
{username} and you keep making the same call. Starting to look like a habit.
Ten straight with {username}. Good people are hard to find.
A ten-match run with {username}. You two know how to stick together.
Ten for ten with {username}. I'm impressed. Keep it between us.
details: That's what having someone's back looks like.
Keep showing up for each other.
Hard to argue with that record.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. That's not a streak. That's a crew.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd want you both on my side.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. You two are stubborn. I respect that.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. That's some serious backup.
{streakCount} with {username}. Having someone stick around matters. Trust me.
details: Didn't see that coming. Love to see it.
A team that's hard to knock down.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. This is getting personal.
{username} has gone against you ten times. You two ever agree on anything?
Ten in a row against {username}. Neither of you knows when to quit.
A ten-match run against {username}. That's a lot of stubborn in one place.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd buy a ticket to that showdown.
details: Try talking. Or don't. This is fun.
Neither one of you backs down. Figures.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. That's a feud with its own postcode.
{streakCount} in a row against {username}. Neither of you gives an inch.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. At this point, it's tradition.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Somebody's going to need a referee.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect the commitment. Maybe get a hobby, too.
details: Neither of you knows when to quit.
A rivalry for the record books.
Glad I'm not caught between you.
Somebody's got to call the next round.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. You haven't voted. Don't make me come find you.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Pick a side already.
{matchTitle} is done in {timeLeft}. Your vote's still missing.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Come on, move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me drag you over here.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You know what to do.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last chance. Make it count.
{timeLeft} left. Pick one. Now.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Don't freeze up.
{matchCount} matches you haven't voted in are closing. First one's done in {timeLeft}. Get moving.
{matchCount} unvoted matches are running out of time. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody's gotta throw the first punch.
{moment1} against {moment2} and nobody's moved. Fine. I'll wait. Briefly.
Brand-new match. Zero votes. Get in there first.
{matchTitle} is wide open. Go on, make the first move.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. Come on, I've seen bigger crowds in the Lanes.
Barely anyone's voted here. Let's change that.
Low turnout. You lot saving your energy for something?
Nobody's weighed in yet. Get a few people in here.
details: This could use a bigger crowd.
Every vote counts in a fight this close.
Your vote can actually move things here.
Don't let this one get buried.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied. You haven't voted. Want to do something about that?
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote breaks it. Yours could.
Tied. Somebody has to make a move. Why not you?
{moment1} and {moment2}, even. Pick a side and stand by it.
Still tied and closing soon. This is your shot to break it.
Level with time running out. Don't leave the decision to chance.
Tied, almost out of time. Step up or let it ride.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Let's get to it.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. No point standing around.
Round {round} is live. {matchCount} matches to get through. Nice.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your side and stick to it.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches waiting. Try not to overthink it.
{momentTitle} won. Knew it had a fight in it.
{momentTitle} is through. Good eye.
{momentTitle} took the round. Clean hit.
{momentTitle} won, and it earned every vote.
{momentTitle} advances. That's what happens when you don't quit.
{momentTitle} moves on. All right, that's a good result.
details: That's how you finish a fight.
You saw something in it. You were right.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. Yeah, that one's going to sting.
{momentTitle} is out. Not what I wanted. Not much we can do now.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Take a breath. There's another round.
{momentTitle} went down fighting. I'll give it that.
{momentTitle} is out. I hate losing. Doesn't mean we stay down.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Let it hurt, then move on.
{momentTitle} got knocked out. We find the next fight.
details: Take the hit. Get back up.
You don't have to like the result. Just don't quit.

messages: New face? All right. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one and get stuck in.
First time here? {liveCount} matches need votes. Don't overthink it.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches live. Let's see what you've got.
{liveCount} matches open. Pick a side. You can change your mind next time.
Welcome in. {liveCount} matches waiting. Try not to start a fight in the comments.
Day two. Back for more? Good. I like a bit of persistence.
Two days running. You're getting comfortable here.
Back for day two. Was starting to think you'd found something better.
{days} days gone. Thought you'd got yourself lost. Good to see you.
Look who's back after {days} days. Everything all right?
{days} days away. You missed a bit. Glad you came back.
Been {days} days. No lecture. Just don't disappear again, all right?
You're back. Good. Thought I'd have to do this alone.
Hey. Welcome back. Matches aren't going to vote on themselves.
Back already? All right, let's see what's happening.
There you are. Come on, we've got things to do.
Still deciding? Pick the one you believe in. Simple.
Quit staring at it. Watch both, trust your gut, make the call.
They're both worth a look. Doesn't mean you can sit here all day.
You've thought about it enough. Pick one and stand by it.
details: Your vote counts. Don't waste it.
No one gets to make the call for you.

messages: First vote. There you go. Wasn't so hard, was it?
You picked a side. Good. Now don't let anyone talk you out of it.
details: That's one in the books. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes already. You're warming up.
Five in. All right, you're not just passing through.
details: Good start. Keep your guard up. +{xp} XP
Five down. Plenty more to see. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes. Guess this place is growing on you.
Ten already. Starting to know your way around.
Twenty-five votes. You're making yourself heard.
Twenty-five. That's a crowd worth listening to.
Fifty votes. You're properly invested now.
Fifty. Okay, you care about this more than you're letting on.
A hundred votes. That's one hell of a run.
One hundred. All right, that's impressive. Don't make me say it twice.
details: You earned every bit of it. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days straight. You keep showing up.
Three in a row. Starting to look like a habit.
A whole week. That's some staying power.
Seven days straight. You don't quit easily, do you?
details: A week in the fight. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Someone's got a lot of opinions.
Fourteen days straight. I'm starting to think nothing slows you down.
details: Two weeks on your feet. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. You stuck around. That means something. Thanks.
A whole month. You don't just show up when it's easy. I respect that.
details: A month in the crew. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You don't mind taking the harder side.
Five times against the crowd. Good. Think for yourself.
details: Five calls of your own. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs. You like a fight nobody expects you to win.
Fifteen against the odds. You really don't like being told what to pick.
Thirty underdogs. You keep backing the one everyone counts out.
Thirty long shots. You see something the rest of the crowd misses.
details: Hard to call. Harder to stop. +{xp} XP
Thirty times against the odds. +{xp} XP

messages: First in five matches. You don't hang around waiting.
Five times you got there before the crowd. Fast hands.
Fifteen early votes. You don't wait for someone else to make the move.
First again and again. Starting to think you've got a sixth sense.
details: You move when it matters. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You must like living on the edge.
Another tight finish. You're calmer than I would've been.
details: You can handle the pressure. +{xp} XP
Ten matches down to the wire. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps tipping the balance.
You've made the difference more than once. Don't get a big head.
details: You know when to step in. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you backed the one that was behind. Stubborn. That's useful.
You don't walk away just because the odds look bad. I get that.
Same moment three times. You know what you like.
That one again? All right. Clearly it got to you.
details: Three votes for one moment. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That's commitment.
You keep picking that one. Can't argue with loyalty.
details: Five votes, no second thoughts. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes for one moment. Okay, you're really attached to this one.
Ten times, same pick. I won't judge. I've had worse habits.
details: You know what you want. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in. You're seeing this through.
You made it to round two. Good. Keep going.
Four rounds. You're a long way from the starting line.
Four rounds in. Now the pressure starts to show.
Six rounds. You saw the whole thing through. Respect.
All six rounds. You didn't walk away. That's what counts.
details: You stayed for every round. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You're checking out the whole place.
Ten different matches. Curious. Good. Look around.
Twenty-five matches. You've been everywhere in this bracket.
Twenty-five. You really do look at everything.
Fifty matches. You know this bracket like the back of your hand.
Fifty. That's not browsing anymore. That's dedication.
details: You've put the time in. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. You planning to take a break at some point?
Five matches back to back. All right, I respect the stamina.
Ten in one go. Take a breath. Seriously.
Ten matches in one sitting. That's commitment, or you lost track of time.
Voting at this hour? Can't sleep either, huh?
Middle of the night. Quiet enough to hear yourself think. Not always a good thing.
You told people about this? Thanks. Means a lot.
Five shares. Nice. More people in the room, better fight.
Fifteen shares. You're practically recruiting the whole Lanes.
Fifteen times you've spread the word. You're good at getting people moving.
You were here at the start. That makes you one of the originals.
One of the first thousand. You helped get this thing off the ground.
details: You were here from day one. +{xp} XP
Nobody can take that from you. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. You earned every step.
Moved up. Don't let it go to your head. Much.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. All right, nice work.
Another one down: {name}. Keep moving.
{name}. Not bad. Not bad at all.
{name}. That's how you get it done.
Ha. {name}. Knew you had it in you.
{name}. You put the work in.
Good work. {name} is yours.
{name}. Put that somewhere people can see it.
{name}. Keep that up and we'll get along fine.
One more down: {name}. Still standing?
{rank}. You've put the work in. It shows.
You put in the work. No shortcuts. That's how I like it.
Ten underdogs. You don't scare easy. I know the type.
Ten long shots. Stubborn enough to make it work. I respect that.
details: Ten calls against the odds. +{xp} XP
You backed the ones nobody expected. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. You two must be getting used to the pressure.
Ten tight finishes with Cupcake. Don't tell her I said you did well.
Seven days with Cait. She's rubbing off on you. Hope it's the good parts.
A week with Cupcake. You must have learned to follow instructions.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Even Cait would call that a good shot.
A tied match, and you made the call. Nice work, cupcake.
Good. I've got your back. Just try to keep up.
Vi's in. All right, let's get this over with.

upcoming: Not open yet. Give it a minute. I'm not going anywhere.
Voting hasn't started. I'll let you know when it does.
Locked for now. Don't go breaking anything while you wait.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both before you make your call.
Give them both a look. You wouldn't swing blind, would you?
I'm not picking for you. That's your decision.
Take a second. Then trust your gut.
Pick the one that hits harder. You know what I mean.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Go on, be the first.
Quiet in here. Somebody make a move.
Empty board. You could change that.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you haven't voted. Come on, get in there.
Time's running down. Make your pick.
closing-3h: Three hours or less. No more stalling.
Clock's getting short. Get your vote in.
voted-early: You got in early. Good. Always better to make your own call.
Hardly any votes in and you picked anyway. That's confidence.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. Don't get comfortable.
{pct}% with you. Good start. Keep an eye on it.
You're in front for now. Doesn't mean the fight's over.
{pick} is pulling ahead. Looks like you called it.
A lead is a lead. Now hold on to it.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm already tense.
One more vote could change everything. Get someone in here.
Neck and neck. Your pick could use a little backup.
voted-tied: Dead even. Nobody's given an inch.
Perfect tie. Annoying. Kind of exciting, though.
voted-behind: You're behind. Doesn't mean you're beaten.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog's got a nice ring to it.
They're ahead. You're just outnumbered. For now.
Behind by {diff} points. Tell someone. Get a few more votes in.
Most people picked the other side. Doesn't make them right.
closed-won: {pick} made it through. You called that one.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. Yeah, that stings. Next one.
It didn't make it. Shake it off. There's another fight.
{pick} is out. Sorry. You picked it for a reason.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side could put the other down.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this one. There'll be another round.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, don't leave it to everyone else.

first-vote: First vote. Good. You had to start somewhere.
That's your first one. See? Easy.
You're in now. Welcome to the fight.
streak: Back again. Good to have you here.
{streak} days running. You don't quit, do you?
Keep coming back like that and I'll start counting on you.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else picked. Takes a bit of nerve.
Hard choice. That's usually the interesting one.
An underdog. Good. I like someone who can make up their own mind.
early: Early vote. You helped set the pace.
Not many votes in yet. Yours could make a real difference.
First through the door. That's how I like it.
close: That vote just tightened things up. It's anyone's match.
Razor-thin margin. One more vote could swing it.
Close one. Your vote matters more than you think.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't beaten. Get some backup.
Not winning yet. All right, then there's work to do.
Down, not out. I've heard that one before.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. People can catch up.
Winning for now. Enjoy it, but keep your eyes open.
Good pick. Looks like you saw something the others missed.
default: All right. Your call. I won't argue. Much.
Vote's in. Come on, there's more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side. Find one that gets your attention.
Everything's open. Take a look. I'll give you a minute.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. All right, a little pressure.
live-some: You've made a start. {unvoted} more waiting.
Good first round. Don't leave the rest hanging.
live-few: Just {unvoted} more. Finish what you started.
Close to clearing the board. Keep going.
live-one: Last one. Don't walk away now.
Just one match between you and done.
live-closing: Some close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your vote.
Clock's running. {unvoted} left and {timeLeft} to go.
Time's almost up. Get those votes in.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Nice work. Go check the bracket.
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens.
All done. Look at you, getting the job finished.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. Check the bracket while we wait.
Quiet for a change. Check back soon.
No matches open. Starting to get bored over here.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each move on. The rest are out.
Everybody starts somewhere. Not everybody makes it through.
Keep an eye on the tables. Things can change fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are next. Top two from each group get through.
No knockout round yet. The groups have to finish first.
Hang on. The knockout bracket comes together when the groups are done.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. Lose once and you're out. No room to coast.
Single elimination. No second chances. Sounds familiar.
Every match matters now. Make your choice count.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and you're done.
Follow the bracket. Gets tighter every round.
Every line here started with somebody making a call.
brackets-complete: That's the cup. Thanks for sticking around. Means something.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss the noise.
Champion's decided. Now that's a finish.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. The draw hasn't happened.
Nothing on the board yet. Give it a minute.
Empty for now. Check back when the draw's done.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote decides it. Get in here.
Two edits, one choice: {a} against {b}. Which one's got it?
{a} versus {b}. Come on, settle this with me.
voted: I picked {pick} over {other}. What about you?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Think I'm wrong? Show me.
I went with {pick} over {other}. Your turn.
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. Get in before the crowd.
I voted early for {pick} over {other}. There's room for yours.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any votes yet. Yours could swing it.
tied: {pick} and {other} are tied. One vote could break it. Yours?
{pick} against {other}, dead even. Come make the call.
{pick} and {other} can't be separated. Maybe you can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. This one's getting good.
Only {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Don't sit this out.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Could go either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes could turn it around.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't out yet. Help.
{pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff}. Still time to hit back.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. Needs a few people in its corner.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}. {pick} deserves a fair shot. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Come on, let's give it a fight.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close. Help hold the lead.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Get your vote in.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A lead worth defending.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Come see what the fuss is about.
{pct}% for {pick}. {other} has some catching up to do.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Still room for your vote.
